card.title: 4th MARINES
card.flavorText: The 4th Marine Regiment was first formed in 1914 and has been more or less active to the present day. In 1942 the regiment was moved to Corregidor in the Phillipine Islands where a Japanese attack was imminent. At the time the defenders consisted largely of the 4th Marines and elements of several other units, both US and Filipino, and many of them were Navy and Army personnel with no ground combat training or experience. As soon as the Japanese soldiers landed on the island faced fierce resistance from the regiment's artillery batteries, but once the Japanese managed to get inland and overcome the batteries the fight was over and the 4th Marines Regiment was destroyed. The 4th Marine Regiment was reestablished in 1944 and would fight with the 6th Marine Division at Guam in 1944 and Okinawa in 1945.
